'''Thasca Knarr''' was a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]]. He was a sneaky and resourceful individual who ruthlessly pursued the accumulation of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Unlike many of his [[Species/Legends|species]], he did not have any artistic talents. He secretly desired to take over [[Exovar's Emporium]].

==Biography==
Thasca was an enterprising merchant who set up a semi-permanent shop within one of the Emporium's private rooms. As a Snivvian he was well protected from the freezing temperatures of [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]

He planned to use the shop as a staging ground to take over control of the Emporium so he could use it as a staging ground for piracy, smuggling, [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunting and [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]].

Over time he was able to quietly bring in mercenaries to aid in his attempted coup but he was opposed by Emporium security [[Redeye (Turazza)|Redeye]] and the two [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] [[NT-X2|Entax]] and [[BT-X2|Botax]].

==Personality and traits==
Thasca's only goal was the constant accumulation of credits. Anything that stood in his way was considered an obstacle to be destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
Thasca Knarr was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]].

He was designed to be an antagonist to the players who would work for Emporium security to help foil Thasca's attempted coup.
